# Dilan Kochhar

Designs and builds websites, apps, and AI agents solo — and runs a $500/month Search & AI Visibility retainer (technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data, answer-engine optimization, monthly reporting). Founder of Dilly (hellodilly.com), a career platform for college students.
